title: Çelik yumruk
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: medieval pixel-art battle VFX ANIMATION SPRITE SHEET. Reference1 is the source atlas; reference2 is the Defender palette/style only. Generate only the requested element, never the character or other elements.
ONE animation sheet, exactly EIGHT chronological frames in a 4 COLUMN x 2 ROW invisible grid, all equal SQUARE cells. Reading order left to right, top row then bottom row. Canvas ideally 1024x512, 256x256 each cell. Actual alpha-transparent background, no painted checkerboard. Each frame entirely inside its own cell, minimum24px padding. Locked camera, fixed pixel scale, consistent design across frames. Make this one coherent action animation, not unrelated asset variations.
Crisp pixel art with stepped pixel clusters. Steel grey, dull brass, earth brown/dust, subdued navy where applicable; muted brick red ONLY for war cry. No magic glow, neon, bloom, blur or airbrush. Dark 1px outline ONLY on solid objects, NEVER dust, smoke, sound arcs, shimmer or sparks. No text, labels, grid borders, watermark, floor scene or decorative extras.
Requested subject and frame sequence: Giant STEEL GAUNTLET closed fist pointing DOWN, strictly SIDE VIEW, brass cuff, same design as atlas. Animate a downward punch and recovery: frames1-2 raised preparation, 3 descending, 4 lowest impact pose, 5 rebound, 6-8 return to raised preparation. Keep fist CLOSED in every frame, fingers down and wrist uppermost. Only isolated gauntlet, no arm, no dust, no ground, no impact star.
